chat.consent: Ask for consent before the chat starts
chat.consent_placeholder: By chatting with us you agree to our privacy policy.
chat.delay_now: When: at the start of the chat
chat.email: Email when a visitor asks for a person
chat.email_bad: This does not look like an email address.
chat.email_hint: Once per conversation, so nobody waits unseen.
chat.hours_bad: The chat must open before it closes.
chat.hours_line: Outside these hours the chat shows your offline message. No day set: always open.
chat.lead_hint: A short form in the chat; what they give becomes a contact and a lead.
chat.offline_placeholder: We are closed now. Leave a message and we will reply in the morning.
chat.rating: Ask visitors to rate the chat when it is resolved
chat.rating_placeholder: How was your chat with us?
chat.sound: Play a sound in the inbox when a visitor writes
chat.whatsapp_bad: Use digits, spaces, + and brackets only (6 to 32).
chat.whatsapp_hint: With the country code. Shows a WhatsApp button in the chat; empty hides it.

fix_first: Some fields need another look before saving.

install.api_line: For a custom integration, you can replace the widget's API key.
install.code_line: Paste this once into your website, just before </body>. The chat then shows on every page.
install.copy_failed: The browser did not allow copying. Select the code and copy it by hand.
install.html_steps: Paste the code just before </body> on every page, or once in the shared footer template.
install.iframe: Your site does not allow scripts? Use a frame instead
install.key_line: The code above contains this key; it never changes, so the code keeps working.
install.off: The chat is switched off in Look, so the code shows nothing yet.
install.regenerate_line: The widget's API key is replaced by a new one. The code on your website is not affected: it uses the widget key, which stays the same.
install.regenerated: A new API key was made. Your website code is unchanged.
install.shopify_steps: Online store → Themes → Edit code → theme.liquid: paste it just before </body>.
install.squarespace_steps: Settings → Advanced → Code injection: paste it into the Footer box.
install.webflow_steps: Site settings → Custom code → Footer code: paste it and publish the site.
install.wix_steps: Settings → Custom code → Add custom code: paste it, choose "All pages" and "Body – end".
install.wordpress_steps: Use a plugin such as "Insert Headers and Footers" (WPCode): paste the code into the footer box and save.

line: The chat on your website: how it looks, how it greets visitors, and how to put it on your site.

look.active: The chat shows on your website
look.active_hint: Switched off, the code stays on your site but shows nothing.
look.avatar_hint: A square PNG or JPG, at most 2 MB. Saved as soon as it is uploaded.
look.colours_hint: Leave a code empty to use the template's colour.
look.launcher_title: The button that opens the chat
look.show_branding: Show a line under the chat
look.suggestions_hint: Up to six, on the welcome screen. A tap sends the question.
look.template_hint: Picking one sets its colours, font and launcher; change any of them after.
look.welcome_subtitle_placeholder: Ask about prices, opening hours or a booking.

preview.heading: Preview
preview.hello: Hello! How can I help you today?
preview.label: Preview of the chat on your website
preview.question: Do you have a table for four on Friday?
preview.title: Chat with us

read_only: Only an owner or a manager can change the chat widget. You can read everything here.
saved: Saved. Your website shows the change within a minute.
unsaved: You have changes that are not saved yet. The website shows them after saving.
